li.label: covert
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moves with practiced subtlety, making [PAWN_objective] much harder to detect. Whether stalking prey or slipping through shadows, [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to stay unseen.

li.label: club-footed
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] struggles to move quietly, often giving away [PAWN_possessive] position with clumsy footsteps. Hunting and stealth are a challenge for [PAWN_objective], as silence does not come naturally.
